value.rationale: Spiders are the canonical trees with one branching vertex, and the source literature explicitly treats tree-family unimodality as a central question. The theorem determines every coefficient for all spiders, gives a unique smallest nonunimodal spider at order 22, and supplies an infinite exact counterfamily, improving the source paper’s smallest broom counterexample at order 24.
